notes.name: case_narrative
notes.text: On July 26, 2003, a 32-year-old male was found along a roadway lying in some brambles. He was thrashing about and grinding his teeth. His body temperature was 103° F. He steadily went into full arrest and later died in the emergency room at a medical center . He had a history of cocaine and cannabis abuse. Toxicological examination revealed that he died of co­caine toxicity.
